visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Loop Instead of Exponential Recursion
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The recursive version calls itself twice per step and repeats the same work hundreds of thousands of times. Rewrite it with a loop. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Only the last two values are needed, so the loop keeps two variables and finishes in n steps. The recursion recomputes the same sub-problems exponentially often.
